title: Airline delay compensation policy
content: Passengers delayed more than three hours should receive meal vouchers. Overnight disruptions require hotel support when the delay is controllable by the airline.

title: Weather exception rule
content: Weather, air traffic control, and airport closure events are treated as uncontrollable disruptions. Customer service should explain the reason and provide rebooking options.

title: Premium traveler support
content: Premium travelers receive priority rebooking, lounge assistance, and proactive notifications when a disruption affects a connection window under ninety minutes.

title: Baggage escalation workflow
content: Lost baggage cases older than twenty-four hours should be escalated to the baggage resolution desk. Include bag tag, flight number, destination, and customer contact details.
